description: Land Acquisition - Veddukadu Punakari D/S Division, Kilinochchi District (Sec. 05)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains declarations for acquiring specific land parcels (with detailed descriptions of boundaries, extents, and locations) for public purposes. The content focuses exclusively on land/property matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories. The mention of the minister's name is incidental to the land acquisition declaration process and does not constitute a personnel appointment or portfolio description that would trigger government classification types.
